_comment: NPC catalog — non-player characters the game references by id. Each record carries a name, sprite (rendered when the NPC appears on a map or in dialog), `personal_history` (the long backstory text designers and writers can lean on for voice / motivation), and a `dialogs` array. Each dialog is a { id, title, text } record so quests / scripts can reference a specific dialog by stable id (e.g. npc.dialogs.where('id', 'introduction')). The `id` on a dialog is unique within the NPC, not globally; the `title` is a short human-readable label for the editor list view. See docs/data_dictionary/npc.md.

npcs.name: Olga
npcs.personal_history: Olga bought her shop after her adventuring brother left her everything.

dialogs.title: Greeting
dialogs.text: Hello fellow traveler, may I interest you in my wares?

npcs.name: Garath
npcs.personal_history: Garath comes from a noble family, but he is a bit of a scoundrel.

npcs.name: Sheep
npcs.personal_history: Yesterday, the sheep ate some grass

npcs.name: Agnetha
npcs.personal_history: Agnetha is a musician from up North

dialogs.title: Love
dialogs.text: In the North, we talk about Love. In these parts it is all ghosts and goblins. We sing to remind the spirits to move on.

npcs.name: Frida
npcs.personal_history: Frida had a difficult childhold living under the yoke of the Orc King. But, she escaped and brings her music to the Inn.

dialogs.title: Flirting
dialogs.text: Oh look what a handsome bunch we have. Do you like my guitar?

npcs.name: Bjorn
npcs.personal_history: Bjorn is a half-elf who has survived by playing his music for The Orc King.

npcs.name: Benoit
npcs.personal_history: Benoit comes from the privileged class in town, playing music is his way to stick his independence in his stuffy family's face.

dialogs.title: What Do You Think?
dialogs.text: Have you read the ancient books? They say that music is the only real philosphy.

npcs.name: Ola
npcs.personal_history: No one knows where Ola comes from. Less people care.

npcs.name: Traveler
npcs.personal_history: This is a fellow traveler, but she is wounded and doesn't have much longer to live.

dialogs.title: Thank the Old Gods
dialogs.text: Oh thank the old gods.... Someone else survived those nasty Orcs. Damn the Orc King, our tribe is no more. Gather what you can from what is left of our caravan. Please seek out the Orc King and destroy him and his kin. Gasp...

npcs.name: Cybil
npcs.personal_history: Cybil gained control of the Shrine of the Deep Ones by making a pack with the Voice of the Deep Ones. To seal her unholy pact, she was required to murder her entire family. The town folk shun Cybil now, but the Deep Ones require all to accept Cybil on there terms and force the town to live with their humiliation so she has continued to be allowed to stay in town.

dialogs.title: What do you want, worms?
dialogs.text: Why do you tread on our holy ground without my permission! If you require healing, be aware, the price is steep and goes far beyond any gold you have to offer.

npcs.name: The Voice of the Orc King
npcs.personal_history: The Voice is nothing but a voice

dialogs.title: Detente?
dialogs.text: Our dear King will not meet with the likes of you, not here, not anywhere. You have one chance to leave this place, or we will extinguish you and your party ending your tribe.
